name: sigbin
notes: Level 3 Sigbin Unit boss. Source cells are 640x400 (character planted at 376 px tall) packed at scale 0.5. Rendered at ENEMY_LOOK scale 2 so the sprite height matches the 192x188 sim body (SIM_PX_PER_ATLAS_PX is 0.5). The quadruped is wider than the 192 px collider; snout and tail overhang. Row 0 idle, row 1 backward walk, row 2 snarl (clip required by enemyClips, unused in the fight), row 3: f0 telegraph/windup, f1 recover with an open dorsal hatch (no painted weak-point diamond; the renderer draws the overlay), f2 mid-collapse, f3 wreck. Frames face right. components.bridge and minArea keep each painted figure as one frame.
